```sql
SELECT 
    p.ID,
    COUNT(*) as abnormal_count
FROM main."Patient" p
JOIN main."Laboratory" l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."GOT" >= 60
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l."Date") = 1997
GROUP BY p.ID
```
